{{Quote|Give us a kiss.|The Zabrak, to Aurra Sing|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
A [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] was a '''patron''' of the [[Quarek'k]], a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The Zabrak, an [[Unidentified Utai patron|Utai]], and a [[Unidentified Shistavanen|Shistavanen]] were [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] together there when [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], entered. The trio tried to get her to consort with them, but she refused and eventually [[Cho mok/Legends|cut off]] the Zabrak's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] before [[Death/Legends|killing]] the other two so she would be left alone.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'd have a large drink, if I were you. The shock will wear off soon, and you'll want to be self-anesthetized by then. But have it somewhere else.|Aurra Sing, on the Zabrak's arm|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
[[File:Aurrahead.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Aurra Sing (pictured) rejected the Zabrak's propositions.]]
A [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Shadows" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]</ref> Soon after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was [[Declaration of a New Order|founded]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was founded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Per the prologue of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', the book takes place the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and the Empire has already risen. Furthermore, it takes place not long after the first ''Coruscant Nights'' [[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight|novel]], which was set directly afterward.</ref> he was [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] heavily alongside two companions&mdash;an [[Unidentified Utai patron|Utai]] and a [[Unidentified Shistavanen|Shistavanen]]&mdash;in [[Section 7-B]] of a large [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] complex called the [[Quarek'k]], when a female [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] entered the establishment. The three of them blocked Sing's path, and the Zabrak tried to proposition the newcomer, but she rejected their advances. On his third attempt, the drunk tried to elicit a kiss from Sing, which prompted her to [[Cho mok/Legends|cleave]] his left [[Limb/Legends|arm]] off at the elbow with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Zabrak's companions tried to assist him, but they were both quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Sing, who allowed the survivor to mesh with the bar's crowd and flee.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't you like my touch?''"<br />"''Not particularly. I also don't like your appearance, your attitude, your breath, and particularly your body odor. You stink.|The Zabrak and Aurra Sing|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
The Zabrak was muscular, tall for his [[Species/Legends|species]], and had prominent [[Tooth/Legends|canines]]. When extremely inebriated, he held no reservations about consorting with Sing, who was of a different [[Near-Human|species]]. Sing was not fond of the Zabrak's attitude, nor his breath, appearance, or stench&mdash;which particularly repulsed her.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zabrak appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', the second novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' trilogy, written by [[Michael Reaves]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Shadows" />
